name: spear_thrust_v1
prompt: A warrior holding a spear with both hands thrusts it straight forward with a step, then pulls it back to a ready stance.

name: spear_sweep_v1
prompt: A warrior holding a long spear with both hands sweeps it in a wide low arc in front of him, then returns to a ready stance.

name: dagger_stab_v1
prompt: A man holding a dagger in his right hand stabs quickly forward twice, then returns to a ready stance.

name: mace_swing_v1
prompt: A warrior holding a heavy mace in his right hand swings it in a big overhead arc down in front of him, then returns to a ready stance.

name: staff_spin_v1
prompt: A fighter holding a long staff with both hands spins it in front of him and strikes forward with one end, then returns to a ready stance.

name: dual_slash_v1
prompt: A warrior holding a sword in each hand slashes with the right sword and then the left sword in quick succession, then returns to a ready stance.

name: shield_block_v1
prompt: A warrior raises a shield on his left arm in front of his body to block a blow, braces, then lowers it to a ready stance.

name: shield_bash_v1
prompt: A warrior steps forward and slams a shield on his left arm into an enemy in front of him, then returns to a ready stance.

name: dodge_roll_v1
prompt: A big man dives into a forward roll on the ground and comes back up into a ready stance.

name: sidestep_v1
prompt: A fighter quickly sidesteps to his left to dodge an attack, then returns to a ready stance.

name: backstep_v1
prompt: A fighter hops quickly backward to dodge an attack, then stands ready.

name: hit_react_v1
prompt: A big man is hit hard in the chest, staggers back two steps, then recovers to a ready stance.

name: hit_react_v2
prompt: A warrior is struck on the head from the side, his head and body jerk to the side, then he recovers.

name: knockdown_v1
prompt: A big man is knocked off his feet, falls onto his back on the ground, then gets back up.

name: death_v1
prompt: A big warrior is fatally wounded, drops to his knees and falls face down on the ground and lies still.

name: cast_push_v1
prompt: A man thrusts both open hands forward to cast a powerful spell, then returns to a ready stance.

name: cast_overhead_v1
prompt: A man raises both hands above his head gathering energy, then slams them down to cast a spell at the ground.

name: roar_v1
prompt: A huge barbarian spreads his arms wide, leans forward and roars at his enemies, then returns to a ready stance.

name: ground_pound_v1
prompt: A huge barbarian raises both fists high and pounds them into the ground in front of him, then stands up.

name: grab_throw_v1
prompt: A big man grabs an enemy in front of him with both hands, lifts him and throws him to the side, then returns to a ready stance.

name: jab_cross_v2_v1
prompt: A boxer bobs slightly and fires a quick jab and a strong cross, then returns to his guard.

name: body_hook_v1
prompt: A boxer dips and throws a left hook to the body, then returns to his guard.

name: slip_counter_v1
prompt: A boxer slips his head to the side to dodge a punch and counters with a right hook, then returns to his guard.

name: low_kick_v1
prompt: A kickboxer throws a low right roundhouse kick to the thigh, then returns to his guard.

name: spinning_kick_v1
prompt: A martial artist spins around and throws a spinning back kick, then returns to his guard.

name: flying_knee_v1
prompt: A fighter jumps forward and drives a flying knee up into an enemy, then lands in his guard.

name: teep_combo_v1
prompt: A kickboxer pushes forward with a front kick, follows with a right cross and a left hook, then returns to his guard.

name: elbow_v1

name: victory_v1
prompt: A big barbarian raises his fist in the air in victory and beats his chest.
